intro: Our Upmods Flowr makes storage feel serene. With a floral headboard and ample underbed storage, it blends design with utility—no compromise, all comfort.

features.title: Crafted with care, built to support
features.text: Made from engineered wood, our frame offers strong, stable support while complementing your décor with its graceful, thoughtful design.

features.title: Delicate details that bring your room to life
features.text: Our beautifully carved floral headboard adds a touch of timeless charm to your bedroom — soft, graceful, and made to reflect your sense of style.

features.title: Thoughtful storage, made easy
features.text: With accessible underbed box storage, keeping your room tidy feels effortless. It’s the perfect hideaway for extra linen, cushions or anything you want neatly tucked away. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: A finish that feels just right
features.text: The natural wood grain matte finish brings a soft, calming texture to your space — understated, elegant, and soothing to the senses.

features.title: A headboard that stays as lovely as day one
features.text: Protected with a scratch-resistant foil, the carved design stays looking pristine even through everyday life — because beauty should last.

name: Upmods Flowr Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
